title: "High Imatinib Netgrowth Map"

---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load required packages
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Set chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load data}
# Load dataset
data <- read.csv("high_imatinib_netgrowth_data.csv", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Keep only needed columns
data <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(protein_start, alt_aa, netgrowth_mean_corrected)
```

```{r prep grid}
# Create a background grid over positions and amino acids
background_grid <- expand.grid(
  protein_start = seq(241, 513, by = 1),
  alt_aa = c("P","G","Y","W","F","V","L","I","A","T",
             "S","Q","N","M","C","E","D","R","K","H"),
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Merge observed values onto the full grid
merged_data_high <- background_grid %>%
  dplyr::left_join(data, by = c("protein_start","alt_aa"))

# Cap extreme values for a stable legend
merged_data_high <- merged_data_high %>%
  dplyr::mutate(netgrowth_mean_corrected = dplyr::case_when(
    !is.na(netgrowth_mean_corrected) & netgrowth_mean_corrected >=  0.06993864 ~  0.06993864,
    !is.na(netgrowth_mean_corrected) & netgrowth_mean_corrected <= -0.06148545 ~ -0.06148545,
    TRUE ~ netgrowth_mean_corrected
  ))

# Wild-type sequence for positions 242:512 (used to outline self-mutations)
wt_df <- data.frame(
  wt_aa = c("I","T","M","K","H","K","L","G","G","G","Q","Y","G","E","V","Y","E","G","V","W","K","K","Y","S","L","T","V","A","V","K","T","L","K","E","D","T","M","E","V","E","E","F","L","K","E","A","A","V","M","K","E","E","I","K","H","P","N","L","V","Q","L","L","G","V","C","T","R","E","P","P","F","Y","I","I","T","E","F","M","T","Y","G","N","L","L","D","Y","L","R","E","C","N","R","Q","E","V","N","A","V","V","L","L","Y","M","A","T","Q","I","S","S","A","M","E","Y","L","E","K","K","N","F","I","H","R","D","L","A","A","R","N","C","L","V","G","E","N","H","L","V","K","V","A","D","F","G","L","S","R","L","M","T","G","D","T","Y","T","A","H","A","G","A","K","F","P","I","K","W","T","A","P","E","S","L","A","Y","N","K","F","S","I","K","S","D","V","W","A","F","G","V","L","L","W","E","I","A","T","Y","G","M","S","P","Y","P","G","I","D","L","S","Q","V","Y","E","L","L","E","K","D","Y","R","M","E","R","P","E","G","C","P","E","K","V","Y","E","L","M","R","A","C","W","Q","W","N","P","S","D","R","P","S","F","A","E","I","H","Q","A","F","T","M","F","Q","E","S","S","I","S","D","E","V","E","K","E","L","G","K"),
  protein_start = 242:512,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

merged_data_high <- merged_data_high %>%
  dplyr::left_join(wt_df, by = "protein_start") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(self_mutation = !is.na(wt_aa) & (alt_aa == wt_aa))

# Legend limits
min_val <- min(merged_data_high$netgrowth_mean_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)
max_val <- max(merged_data_high$netgrowth_mean_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)
midpoint_val <- 0
```

```{r plot}
# Simple heatmap (single scale); self-mutations are yellow
plot <- ggplot() +
  # 1) Gradient for all tiles (you can exclude self tiles if you like; not required)
  geom_tile(
    data = merged_data_high,
    aes(x = protein_start, y = alt_aa, fill = netgrowth_mean_corrected),
    width = 1, height = 1, na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  # 2) Draw wild-type tiles on top in solid yellow (constant fill, no scale)
  geom_tile(
    data = merged_data_high %>% dplyr::filter(self_mutation),
    aes(x = protein_start, y = alt_aa),
    width = 1, height = 1,
    fill = "yellow",           # << key: constant fill, not mapped
    color = NA,                # or "yellow" if you also want a border
    linewidth = 0.3,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue", mid = "#9999FF", high = "red",
    midpoint = midpoint_val,
    name = "Net growth rate",
    na.value = "grey80",
    limits = c(min_val, max_val),
    breaks = c(min_val, midpoint_val, max_val),
    labels = c(sprintf("%.4f", min_val), sprintf("%.4f", midpoint_val), sprintf("%.4f", max_val))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Residue position on BCR-ABL kinase",
    limits = c(241, 513),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    name = "Mutant Amino Acid",
    limits = c("P","G","Y","W","F","V","L","I","A","T","S","Q","N","M","C","E","D","R","K","H")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Mutation Netgrowth Map under 1200 nM imatinib") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey80"),
    aspect.ratio = 1/4,
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 9),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Display in HTML
plot

# Save to files
ggsave("High_imatinib_netgrowth_map_simple.png", plot, dpi = 600, width = 10, height = 7.2, units = "in")
ggsave("High_imatinib_netgrowth_map_simple.pdf", plot, dpi = 600, width = 10, height = 7.2, units = "in")
```
